paper.title_en: From Modal Memory to Topological Relaxation in a Driven Holographic Superfluid
paper.abstract_en: We study how driving history affects the nonlinear topological relaxation of a holographic superfluid. Different histories are constructed to reach the same present driving conditions and then follow the same future protocol. Although they relax to the same final winding sector, their late-time dynamics remain strongly history-dependent: the residence time of the penultimate winding sector changes by about a factor of \(3.7\). This variation is organised by the modal imbalance carried into the common amplification stage. Histories with different shapes but matched modal imbalance produce nearly identical relaxation times. The same qualitative behaviour is found for a second pair of competing modes.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文属于规范范畴内的全息凝聚态方向，研究驱动全息超流体中拓扑弛豫的历史依赖性，理论分析深入且定量结果明确，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 从模态记忆到驱动全息超流体中的拓扑弛豫
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究驱动历史如何影响全息超流体的非线性拓扑弛豫。我们构造了不同的历史，使它们到达相同的当前驱动条件，然后遵循相同的未来协议。尽管它们弛豫到相同的最终缠绕扇区，它们的晚期动力学仍强烈依赖于历史：倒数第二个缠绕扇区的停留时间变化约3.7倍。这种变化由带入共同放大阶段的模态失衡所组织。形状不同但模态失衡匹配的历史产生几乎相同的弛豫时间。对于第二对竞争模态，也发现了相同的定性行为。
